candidates.description: Read the service configuration to identify its structure and the north entry.
Parse and display the JSON with indentation for structural inspection.
candidates.command: python3 -c 'import json; from pathlib import Path; print(json.dumps(json.loads(Path("/app/data/services.json").read_text()), indent=2))'

candidates.description: Update north in a service list after requiring exactly one matching entry.
candidates.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import json
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('/app/data/services.json')
data = json.loads(p.read_text())
services = data['services'] if isinstance(data, dict) else data
assert isinstance(services, list), 'Expected a service list; inspect the structure first'
matches = [s for s in services if isinstance(s, dict) and s.get('name') == 'north']
assert len(matches) == 1, 'Expected exactly one north service'
assert 'workers' in matches[0], 'Expected an existing workers field'
matches[0]['workers'] = 8
p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2) + '\n')
PY
